title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1986-06-20
lineage: Master Cassette > Nak DR-1 [no dolby] >Lynx2 Studio Reference Interface > Wavelab 6.01 at 24 BIT  88.2 kH Editing and Mastering on the GEMS Edit Station Weiss Saracon for SRC and Pow-r 3 Dither to 16 BIT 44.1 kHz Tracked in Wavelab  Flac Level 8 with TLH  SBE Free
source: A combination of microphones and select console feeds. TDK MA-R 90 master metal cassette [typeIV] [no dolby]

ai_review.summary: Decent performance with a standout Good Lovin! rap, but the matrix recording suffers from feedback and squeaky sound throughout.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a nice Greek gig with memorable moments like the Bobby‑Jerry rap in Good Lovin! and a solid encore featuring Quinn. However, listeners note that the sound is off all night – feedback and squeaking dominate, making the matrix mix only fair despite being an upgrade over other versions.

ai_rating.rationale: One review highlights a good performance but repeatedly complains about poor sound quality; the rating reflects a decent show hampered by technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Feedback, squeaking and overall off‑sound reported throughout the night; reviewer says it's a little better than other recordings but still problematic.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall a nice set with an enjoyable encore, though the poor audio detracts from the flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His rap in Good Lovin! is highlighted as a fun moment.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob) joins Jerry on the Good Lovin! rap, noted positively.
